description: The Sigmund King Bed blends modern rustic styling with exceptional comfort. Crafted from solid Asian hardwoods, oak veneers, and engineered woods, it features a rich sable stain paired with a cream polyester-upholstered headboard insert—creating a cozy spot for reading or watching TV. Softly rounded corners, smooth edges, and the signature Sigmund open-space design complete the look, bringing warmth and contemporary character to any bedroom.
techspecs:
The Sigmund King Bed blends modern rustic styling with exceptional comfort. Crafted from solid Asian hardwoods, oak veneers, and engineered woods, it features a rich sable stain paired with a cream polyester-upholstered headboard insert—creating a cozy spot for reading or watching TV. Softly rounded corners, smooth edges, and the signature Sigmund open-space design complete the look, bringing warmth and contemporary character to any bedroom.

Features:
• Expertly crafted of solid Asian hardwoods, oak veneers, engineered woods, polyester fabric and foam.
• Kiln-dried wood helps prevent warping, splitting, cracking and developing mildew
• Adjustable levelers add stability on uneven surfaces.

• The wood is hand-stained in a natural multi-step sable finish to highlight the natural grain and knots of the wood.
• The wire-brushed finish adds depth and character to the chair, making it a truly unique and stylish addition to any space.
• The King bed includes a four-slat support system with dual center supports to enhance stability and help prevent mattress sagging. A box spring is recommended for optimal performance.
• Product Measurements: 80.5″W x 88″D x 54″H
